# Pricing

## Transcript

Lenny (00:00):
Let's talk about pricing and packaging.

Bob Sample (00:20):
Most founders underprice. Start by asking customers what they would be disappointed to lose, then run a willingness to pay survey. We raised prices forty percent and churn barely moved because we had anchored on value metrics rather than seats.

Bob Sample (02:05):
Run a pricing experiment on new signups only, never on existing customers, and keep the experiment running for at least one full billing cycle.
